name: expandable-card
title: Expandable card
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A dense card that grows in width and height to show more, and closes with Escape.

meta.descriptionEs: Una tarjeta densa que crece en ancho y alto para mostrar el detalle. Escape la cierra.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
